title: Oracle table at a given index
statement: For natural numbers $k$, $n$, and $r$, let $C_{k,n}$ be the finite type of canonical oracle-machine tables. If $r<|C_{k,n}|$, the definition returns the well-formed Boolean oracle Turing machine represented by the table at index $r$ in the enumeration of $C_{k,n}$; if $r\ge |C_{k,n}|$, it returns the default Boolean oracle Turing machine.
caveat: The snippet does not include the definitions of the canonical table type, its enumeration, or the default machine, so their details cannot be stated more precisely.
